learning_outcomes.text: Students are able to independently work on a practice-oriented task from the field of mechanical engineering or industrial engineering, both in its specific technical details and in its interdisciplinary contexts, using scientific and practical methods, within a given timeframe.
Students are able to structure a challenging problem and work on it under time constraints.

syllabus_topics: The content of the Bachelor's thesis is theme-dependent. The topic of each Bachelor's thesis is assigned by a professor from the department. Students can suggest topics.

assessment_methods.method: Written elaboration of the Bachelor's thesis topic

assessment_rules: The relevance of the grade for the final grade is determined by the Bachelor's examination regulations (BPO).
